desc: She is a chibi dragon girl with long wavy silver-lavender hair, a pair of curled pale purple dragon horns, a white rose hair ornament, pointed elf ears, purple eyes, a white dress with a flowing sheer overskirt, bat wings, a white scaly dragon tail, and a small blue cloud spirit floating at her right side.
arms: both hands, the bracelets, and the long flowing white sleeve on her raised arm
head_extra: the dragon horns, the pointed ears and the white rose ornament
nobody_keep: the long silver-lavender back hair, the bat wings, the white dragon tail and the small blue cloud spirit

poses.working: Change only her arms: both hands now held in front of her chest at stomach height, fingers lightly curled downward as if typing on an invisible floating keyboard. Do not draw any keyboard.
poses.reading: Change only her arms: she holds a light cyan translucent data tablet with both hands in front of her chest and looks at it.
poses.thinking: Change only her arms: her right hand (on the left side of the image) is raised with the index finger touching her chin while thinking; her other arm rests across her waist.
poses.dragged: Change only her arms: both arms raised up and outward, hands open and flailing in panic as if she is being picked up.

props.thinking: the blue cloud-shaped thought bubbles with gears and the small bubbles
props.reading: the light cyan translucent data tablet she holds
props.working: the green holographic keyboard in front of her and the green holographic screens beside her
